meta-runner.name: Generate License Files
meta-runner.description: Generate the third-party license files of a component version through the license service (report only). Requires two environment variables, set on the agent or the build configuration: * env.LICENSE_SERVICE_URL - the license service base URL * env.LICENSE_RUNNER_JAVA_HOME - a JDK 25 home, used to download and run the runner The report and the license files are written to LICENSE_OUTPUT_DIR; publish it with the build's artifact rules.

param.name: COMPONENT_NAME
param.spec: text description='Component name in the components registry' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: LICENSE_OUTPUT_DIR
param.spec: text description='Directory for the report and the license files' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: LICENSE_RUNNER_ARGS
param.spec: text description='Extra license-runner options, e.g. --timeout PT45M' display='normal'
